name: Cloudflare
summary_en: Fast public resolver with a strong privacy focus.
summary_id: Resolver publik cepat yang berfokus pada privasi.
pros_id: Cepat, mengutamakan privasi, jaringan global luas
cons_en: Does not block ads or adult content by default
cons_id: Tidak memblokir iklan atau konten dewasa secara bawaan

profiles.description_en: Cloudflare standard public DNS without content filtering.
profiles.description_id: DNS publik standar Cloudflare tanpa pemfilteran konten.

profiles.description_en: Automatically blocks malware, phishing, and known malicious domains.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir malware, phishing, dan domain berbahaya secara otomatis.

profiles.description_en: Blocks malware as well as adult and sexually explicit content.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir malware serta konten dewasa dan pornografi untuk keluarga.

name: Google Public DNS
summary_en: Reliable resolver backed by Google's global infrastructure.
summary_id: Resolver andal yang didukung infrastruktur global Google.
pros_id: Ketersediaan tinggi, andal, didukung secara luas
cons_en: Some users may prefer a provider outside Google's ecosystem
cons_id: Sebagian pengguna mungkin memilih penyedia di luar ekosistem Google

profiles.description_en: Google's global Anycast DNS network with high availability and low latency.
profiles.description_id: Jaringan DNS Anycast global Google dengan ketersediaan tinggi dan latensi rendah.

name: Quad9
summary_en: Security-focused resolver that blocks known malicious domains.
summary_id: Resolver keamanan yang memblokir domain berbahaya yang diketahui.
pros_en: Malware and phishing protection, non-profit operator
pros_id: Perlindungan malware dan phishing, dikelola organisasi nirlaba
cons_en: Threat filtering can occasionally block a wanted domain
cons_id: Penyaringan ancaman terkadang dapat memblokir domain yang diinginkan

profiles.description_en: Blocks malware, phishing, and spyware with DNSSEC validation enabled.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir malware, phishing, dan spyware dengan validasi DNSSEC aktif.

profiles.description_en: Includes subnet info to route traffic to geographically closest CDN edges.
profiles.description_id: Menyertakan info subnet untuk merutekan lalu lintas ke server CDN terdekat.

profiles.description_en: Raw resolution without threat blocking or domain filtering.
profiles.description_id: Resolusi langsung tanpa pemblokiran domain ancaman atau filter.

name: AdGuard DNS
summary_en: Resolver that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains.
summary_id: Resolver yang memblokir iklan, pelacak, dan domain berbahaya.
pros_id: Pemblokiran iklan dan pelacak untuk seluruh jaringan
cons_en: Filtering can affect sites that depend on ad or tracking domains
cons_id: Penyaringan dapat memengaruhi situs yang bergantung pada domain iklan

profiles.description_en: Blocks advertisements, tracking domains, and malicious websites.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir iklan banner, domain pelacak analitik, dan situs berbahaya.

profiles.description_en: Blocks ads, trackers, adult content, and enforces SafeSearch.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir iklan, pelacak, konten dewasa, serta mengaktifkan SafeSearch.

profiles.description_en: Fast, reliable DNS without any ad, tracking, or content filtering.
profiles.description_id: DNS netral dan cepat tanpa pemblokiran iklan atau pelacak apa pun.

name: CleanBrowsing
summary_en: Family-friendly resolver blocking adult content and phishing.
summary_id: Resolver ramah keluarga yang memblokir konten dewasa dan phishing.
pros_en: Safe for kids and families, blocks malicious content
pros_id: Aman untuk keluarga dan anak, memblokir konten berbahaya
cons_en: May restrict access to mixed-content or false-positive domains
cons_id: Dapat membatasi akses ke domain berkonten campuran

profiles.description_en: Blocks adult content, proxy/VPN bypass sites, and enforces SafeSearch.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir konten dewasa, situs bypass VPN, dan menegakkan SafeSearch.

profiles.description_en: Blocks explicit adult sites while leaving other mixed-content open.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir situs dewasa eksplisit tanpa membatasi situs umum lainnya.

profiles.description_en: Blocks phishing, malware, and malicious domains without filtering adult content.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir phishing, malware, dan domain berbahaya tanpa filter konten dewasa.

name: Control D
summary_en: Modern customizable resolver blocking ads, malware, and trackers.
summary_id: Resolver modern yang memblokir iklan, malware, dan pelacak.
pros_en: Fast Anycast network, built-in malware & ad blocking
pros_id: Jaringan Anycast cepat, pemblokir malware & iklan bawaan
cons_en: Custom profile features require an online Control D account
cons_id: Fitur kustomisasi profil lanjutan membutuhkan akun Control D

profiles.description_en: Blocks advertisements, tracking domains, malware, and phishing sites.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir iklan, pelacak data, malware, dan situs penipuan phishing.

profiles.description_en: Blocks malicious domains and phishing without altering web advertisements.
profiles.description_id: Hanya memblokir malware dan phishing tanpa mengubah iklan pada situs.

profiles.description_en: Blocks adult content, malware, and deceptive websites for household browsing.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir pornografi, malware, dan situs berbahaya untuk seluruh anggota keluarga.

profiles.description_en: Blocks popular social media platforms for productivity and focused study.
profiles.description_id: Memblokir platform media sosial untuk fokus bekerja dan belajar.

profiles.description_en: High performance Anycast DNS resolution without any content filters.
profiles.description_id: Resolusi DNS Anycast cepat dan andal tanpa pemfilteran konten apa pun.

name: NextDNS
summary_en: Cloud-based resolver with advanced privacy controls and threat prevention.
summary_id: Resolver berbasis cloud dengan privasi tinggi dan pencegahan ancaman.
pros_en: Powerful analytics, granular privacy and security filters
pros_id: Analitik andal, filter privasi dan keamanan terperinci
cons_en: Custom blocking rules require linking an account profile ID
cons_id: Aturan pemblokiran kustom memerlukan penautan profil akun

profiles.description_en: Standard Anycast resolver without custom profile linking.
profiles.description_id: Resolver Anycast standar NextDNS tanpa penautan profil akun kustom.

name: OpenDNS
summary_en: Reliable enterprise-grade resolver by Cisco with phishing protection.
summary_id: Resolver andal kelas enterprise dari Cisco dengan perlindungan phishing.
pros_en: Backed by Cisco infrastructure, 100% uptime, fast lookup
pros_id: Didukung infrastruktur Cisco, uptime 100%, lookup cepat
cons_en: May redirect NXDOMAIN errors to search suggestions page
cons_id: Dapat mengarahkan error NXDOMAIN ke halaman saran pencarian

profiles.description_en: Cisco OpenDNS with automatic phishing protection and 100% uptime.
profiles.description_id: Cisco OpenDNS dengan proteksi phishing otomatis dan ketersediaan 100%.

profiles.description_en: Pre-configured to automatically block adult and illicit content out-of-the-box.
profiles.description_id: Otomatis memblokir konten dewasa dan pornografi langsung tanpa konfigurasi tambahan.

name: LibreDNS
summary_en: No-log encrypted resolver run by the LibreOps collective.
summary_id: Resolver terenkripsi tanpa log yang dikelola kolektif LibreOps.
pros_en: Strict no-log policy, encrypted DNS, resistant to censorship
pros_id: Kebijakan tanpa log, DNS terenkripsi, tahan terhadap sensor
cons_en: Encrypted DNS only, so it cannot be reached over plain DNS; no DNSSEC validation
cons_id: Hanya DNS terenkripsi, tidak bisa diakses lewat DNS biasa; tanpa validasi DNSSEC

profiles.description_en: LibreDNS public resolver that answers every domain without content filtering.
profiles.description_id: Resolver publik LibreDNS yang menjawab semua domain tanpa pemfilteran konten.

profiles.description_en: Filters advertisement and tracking domains using StevenBlack's crowdsourced list.
profiles.description_id: Menyaring domain iklan dan pelacak memakai daftar crowdsourced StevenBlack.

name: Tiarap
summary_en: Privacy-first resolver that blocks ads, trackers, malware, and phishing.
summary_id: Resolver yang mengutamakan privasi serta memblokir iklan, pelacak, malware, dan phishing.
pros_en: Blocks over 3.2M ad, tracking, and malware domains; no logging, no ECS, DNSSEC validation
pros_id: Memblokir lebih dari 3,2 juta domain iklan, pelacak, dan malware; tanpa log, tanpa ECS, dengan validasi DNSSEC
cons_en: Filtering is always on, so there is no unfiltered profile; the network is smaller than the big public resolvers
cons_id: Penyaringan selalu aktif sehingga tidak ada profil tanpa filter; jaringannya lebih kecil dibanding resolver publik besar

profiles.description_en: Filters ads, trackers, malware, scams, and phishing while validating DNSSEC.
profiles.description_id: Menyaring iklan, pelacak, malware, penipuan, dan phishing sekaligus memvalidasi DNSSEC.
